purpose: Evidence-backed ruler photo review; source annotations preserved, approximate corrected readings separate
authorization: User authorized readable ruler photograph values to take precedence over erroneous text annotations. This does not authorize inventing unseen endpoints.

reference_use_policy.allowed_use: Independent trait comparison after calibration, reconstruction settings, physical specimen correspondence and measurement definitions are frozen.
reference_use_policy.report_exclusions: Report missing visibility, unmatched identity, unresolved units and uncertain organs individually. Do not invent unobserved endpoints.

user_protocol.source: Direct user clarification relayed in the current research-readiness task
user_protocol.height_bottom_interpretation: step base interpreted as stem base
user_protocol.height_top_endpoint: very tip of plant / highest plant tip
user_protocol.annotation_units_status: user asserts centimetres, not millimetres; no global conversion applied
user_protocol.remaining_uncertainty: Ruler joining/offset and repeat-measurement uncertainty have not been independently reconstructed from photographs.

acceptance_semantics.accepted_as_photo_reference: Readable approximate candidate reference for this photographed organ/section, with stated visual interval. Does not establish reconstructed identity, instrument calibration or repeatability.
acceptance_semantics.accepted_for_validation: Final numerical validation eligibility. False for every row until same physical specimen/organ and compatible endpoint/length/width conventions are matched and frozen.
acceptance_semantics.operator_reported_heights: Original manual heights are retained and may be compared as operator-reported references after specimen matching. Failure to independently re-read a photo does not prove the measurement is incorrect.
acceptance_semantics.uncertainty: Intervals are cautious visual-reading ranges only, not confidence intervals; ruler calibration, parallax, pose/flattening, temporal change and repeatability remain unquantified.
acceptance_semantics.matching: Folder-to-overview associations are candidates. Agreement with an annotation value is not proof of physical identity. No leaf is yet linked to a reconstructed component.
